name: Dokidoki! Kouboshi Gakuen no Valentine
original_name: ドキドキ！公星学園のバレンタイン
source:
Just three days left until Valentine's Day!
Aim to receive chocolates from a girl after school on the big day!
If you keep the conversation lively and really hit it off, you might just receive some extra-special chocolates...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13501]Novelgame[/url]]
